lines.speaker: Mr. Chen
lines.text: Mrs. Ramirez got you looking first, hm?

lines.speaker: Mr. Chen
lines.text: That's good. Most repairs start by slowing down.

lines.speaker: Mr. Chen
lines.text: This chain has been making a small complaint. Let's listen a little.

lines.speaker: Mr. Chen
lines.text: I put my bike on the repair stand in the garage. Come with me and we'll listen from there.
